title: [IMP-10] HTTP representation of signed objects is undefined (CBOR envelope vs JSON)
description: Review finding IMP-10: HTTP representation of signed objects is undefined (CBOR envelope vs JSON) (lens IMP). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:157-158, :166-167; spec/10-relays.md:49, :102, :315, :359; spec/13-encoding.md:27. Fix: 13:27 already gives the rule a careful implementer follows: an object verified outside MLS "is stored, served and forwarded as its encoded envelope with `sig` present". A detached JWS cannot sit inside a bare JSON file, so the manifest and directories must be envelopes. "signed JSON document" (10:49) and "static JSON file" (10:315) contradict that rule and need fixing. Still undefined: media type, the `/head` response format, the BroadcastKey response, and status codes. Divergence in these is recoverable, so P2. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
